interpretation.headline: Key Factors Driving Insurance Premium Estimate
bullets: Smoker status: Yes; Increased estimate by approximately $8602. Smokers generally face higher premiums due to increased health risks associated with tobacco use.
BMI: 30.4; Increased estimate by about $2473. Higher BMI is often linked to greater health concerns, leading insurers to charge more.
Age: 48; Increased estimate by around $740. Older individuals usually have higher health costs on average, impacting insurance pricing.
Additional features like sex and region had minor influences, with sex slightly increasing and region slightly decreasing the estimate overall.
The predicted cost of $33,216 is notably above the average base value of $21,254, indicating a lifestyle-driven premium largely influenced by smoking and obesity.
caveats: This is a local, model-dependent explanation. Individual circumstances may vary.
